tagline: Laureate Education, Inc. operates a portfolio of degree-granting higher education institutions in Mexico and Peru serving approximately 497,700 students.
hero_kpi_rationale: Student enrollment is the primary non-financial indicator and revenue driver. It directly represents the company's capacity to generate future revenues in its target Mexican and Peruvian markets.

kpis.name: Student Enrollment
kpis.explanation: Total number of students enrolled in the company's institutions on the last day of the reporting period.
kpis.description: Student enrollment is defined as the number of students enrolled in a course on the last day of the reporting period. It represents the primary revenue driver for Laureate.
kpis.signal: Primary indicator of future revenues and key non-financial metric.

kpis.name: Total Revenues
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated by educational activities derived primarily from tuition fees of enrolled students.
kpis.description: Revenues are derived primarily from tuition fees of students enrolled in university programs, as well as student fees and other educational activities.
kpis.signal: 9% year-over-year growth, supported by increased enrollment and pricing adjustments.

kpis.name: Mexico Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated by operations in Mexico, a segment comprising 2 national institutions with over 30 campuses.
kpis.description: Mexican institutions constitute the majority of Laureate's portfolio. The private sector represents approximately 39% of the Mexican higher education market, playing a key role in addressing capacity shortfalls at public universities.
kpis.signal: Mexican market represents 52% of total revenues with 269,400 students.

kpis.name: Peru Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated by operations in Peru, a segment comprising 3 institutions with 20 campuses.
kpis.description: Private universities constitute approximately 76% of the Peruvian higher education market and play an increasingly important role in meeting rising demand, creating significant opportunities for quality institutions.
kpis.signal: Peruvian market contributes 48% of total revenues with 228,300 students.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, value extracted from yfinance.income_stmt for the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Revenue of 1.7 billion euros in the last year

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance for the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 2.21 billion euros in the last year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance for the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 0.52 billion euros in the last year

kpis.name: Cash and Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash and equivalents extracted from yfinance for the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash and equivalents of 0.15 billion euros in the last year

risks.title: Global Minimum Tax
risks.score_rationale: The company could be subject to a global minimum tax following OECD Base Erosion and Profit Shifting initiatives. Details and guidance remain pending. The company does not anticipate a material impact on results.

risks.title: Currency Fluctuations and Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: International operations in Mexico and Peru expose the company to foreign exchange rate fluctuations, possible currency devaluations, inflation and exchange controls, which could affect revenues converted to USD.

risks.title: Increased Competition in Emerging Markets
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in maturing Mexican and Peruvian markets where competition is intensifying. Future success depends on the ability to anticipate and manage competitive risks.

risks.title: Political and Economic Instability
risks.score_rationale: Operations in Mexico and Peru expose the company to complex political, economic and regulatory risks including asset expropriation, inflation and changes in government policies.

risks.title: Multiple and Variable Regulatory Compliance
risks.score_rationale: Activities are subject to complex and variable laws and regulations in Mexico and Peru. Unpredictable regulatory changes could affect operations and compliance costs.

risks.title: Concentrated Geographic Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is entirely dependent on Mexican (52% of revenues) and Peruvian (48% of revenues) markets. This geographic concentration creates vulnerability to regional shocks.

risks.title: Growth and Expansion Management
risks.score_rationale: The organic growth strategy through program additions, demographic expansion and capacity increases requires effective management and risk anticipation.

ai_positioning.summary: LAUR does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning or related technologies in its 10-K filing.
